FAIL=Returns empty string when accesskey is invalid
# ADR 0012: this file is w3c/aria PR 2484, a *proposal*, and it contradicts the
# shipped specification rather than extending it -- with `aria-busy` absent it
# wants "false" where `aria-attribute-reflection.html` wants null. Passing this
# file means failing that one, and the trade was measured rather than argued
# (2026-08-12, by implementing the proposal and reverting it):
#
#                              aria-attribute-reflection   this file
#   DOMString? (shipped, ours)          41/41  (100%)      562/1722 (32.6%)
#   enumerated (PR 2484)                28/41  (68.3%)    1696/1722 (98.5%)
#
# So the proposal is worth +1134 subtests here and -13 there. It is still
# refused, and the number is the reason to write the refusal down rather than to
# reverse it: those 13 are the *shipped* behaviour of every browser, `el.ariaBusy`
# on an element with no `aria-busy` is null in all of them, and a page reading it
# gets an answer no other engine gives. Correctness before pass rate -- see
# AGENTS.md's priority order. Revisit when the proposal ships, not before.
[html/dom/aria-attribute-reflection-enumerated.tentative.html]
